title: Annual report.
bodyText: At least twenty days prior to the convening of each regular session, the authority shall submit to the governor, board of education, and legislature, a complete and detailed report of its activities during the prior fiscal year.
bodyHtml: §302A-1707  Annual report.  At least twenty days prior to the convening of each regular session, the authority shall submit to the governor, board of education, and legislature, a complete and detailed report of its activities during the prior fiscal year. [L 2020, c 72, pt of §1; am L 2021, c 217, §2]
